name: Forest Grove
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Forest Grove, OR 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Forest Grove, OR: A Christmas Story musical, Santa and Mrs. Claus at a tree farm, the Pacific University Holiday Concert and more.
lede: Forest Grove keeps Christmas close to home: a community theater musical on Pacific Avenue, Santa and Mrs. Claus at a family tree farm in the hills, a college holiday concert and a downtown light parade on the first Saturday of December.
celebrates: The season begins on Thanksgiving weekend, when David Hill Farm opens its u-cut fields and Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the farm on four mornings. On the first Saturday of December, the Downtown Association of Forest Grove fills the old town center with Holiday in the Grove, a day of markets, music and Santa that ends with the Holiday Light Parade. Theatre in the Grove stages A Christmas Story: The Musical across three December weekends, and Pacific University gives its Holiday Concert on December 12 in McCready Hall.
lastyear: In 2025 the Downtown Association of Forest Grove held Holiday in the Grove on the first Saturday of December, Saturday, December 6. The day was packed with activities, shopping, food, music, markets and Santa Claus, and the association printed a 2025 brochure of the day's events and holiday deals. The evening ended with the Holiday Light Parade through historic downtown, coordinated by the Western Washington County Firefighters Association and timed to start at dusk.
facts: Forest Grove grew up around a school. In 1848 Tabitha Brown and Harvey Clark founded an orphan home for children whose parents had died on the trail to Oregon, and in 1849 the territorial legislature chartered Tualatin Academy nearby. The academy became Pacific University, one of the oldest in the West. Its trustees chose the name Forest Grove on January 10, 1851, and the town was incorporated in 1872. Today it has twelve buildings on the National Register of Historic Places.
trains: Rail reached Forest Grove in 1870, but the town would not pay the Willamette Valley Railroad $30,000 for a depot, so the station was built a mile south. A streetcar linked downtown with the depot from 1906 until 1911, the Oregon Electric Railroad arrived in 1908 and the Southern Pacific followed in 1912. Today families can drive to Hillsboro and ride TriMet's MAX Blue Line east to Washington Park, home of the zoo railway, or into Portland toward the Oregon Rail Heritage Center.

traditions: On the first Saturday of December, downtown Forest Grove hosts markets, music and Santa, ending with the Holiday Light Parade.
The parade rolls through historic downtown at dusk, coordinated by the Western Washington County Firefighters Association.
Theatre in the Grove's holiday show
The community theater on Pacific Avenue, performing since 1969, stages a family holiday musical each December.
Cutting a tree at David Hill Farm
Families cut their own fir on the farm, then warm up with free hot cocoa by the bonfire.
The university's December concert in McCready Hall, also streamed live.
kidfact: Forest Grove began with a home for children. In 1848 Tabitha Brown helped start an orphan home for kids whose parents had died on the long journey to Oregon, and the school that grew next to it became Pacific University.
faq: When is the Forest Grove Holiday Light Parade in 2026?

The Downtown Association of Forest Grove holds the Holiday Light Parade on the first Saturday of December, which is December 5, 2026, starting at 5 pm. It ends Holiday in the Grove, a day of markets, music and Santa downtown. Parade entries are full for this year.
Where can kids see Santa in Forest Grove?

Santa and Mrs. Claus visit David Hill Farm on November 27 and 28 and December 5 and 12, 2026, from 11 am to 1 pm, with free hot cocoa. Santa is also part of Holiday in the Grove downtown on Saturday, December 5.
Is there a Christmas play for kids in Forest Grove?

Yes. Theatre in the Grove performs A Christmas Story: The Musical from December 4 to 20, 2026, at 2028 Pacific Avenue. Tickets are $22 for adults, $18 for seniors and students, and $9 for children under 8, and 2:30 pm matinees suit younger children.
Where can we cut a Christmas tree near Forest Grove?

David Hill Farm, at 45627 NW David Hill Road, opens on Thanksgiving weekend. U-cut Douglas fir is $10 a foot and Noble, Nordmann and Grand fir are $14 a foot, with a 6-foot minimum, and the farm shakes, bales and loads trees for free.
